name: vsor-site-runtime
description: The materialized site-runtime shell (.vsor/site-runtime). Generated by vsor from this template; the one home of the shell's exact dependency versions (specs/vsor/build). The shell IS the forked app — sor-site-app.tgz is unpacked over this directory, so this file replaces the app's own package.json and must carry everything the app imports: its dependencies at the versions packages/sor-site/package-lock.json resolved, the devDependencies the BUILD needs (the faster toolchain, the postcss/tailwind chain), and the nine workspace libraries as relative file: tarballs. It deliberately does not carry the type-only devDependencies (@types/*, typescript, @docusaurus/tsconfig, @docusaurus/types, @docusaurus/module-type-aliases): nothing in a build reads them, and the shell is scratch, not an editing surface. packages/vsor/tests/test_site_runtime.py asserts the mirror dep-by-dep against packages/sor-site/app/package.json and that lockfile.
